description: TIMBRE TRANSFER (an instrument swap) from a recording: hum or whistle a melody, play it on a kazoo, take a guitar line — and get it back played by a cello, a trumpet, a koto (any doseedo_instruments call). Re-play ONE recorded part — a separated stem, a solo, a region of the user's session — on another instrument, straight from the audio: the recording's FSQ codes carry its structure into a take generated from noise, and the sound is the instrument's (caption + timbre_preset) — the FSQ + timbre combination the cond5 model was trained on (served on its turbo graft). No MIDI by default (midi:true adds the server's own pitch roll of the recording); `fidelity` > 0 also keeps that much of the recording's own latents (closer, but its sound leaks back in). For the exact notes, transcribe and doseedo_render_midi; a whole mix → doseedo_cover_song. result.recipe says what reached the model (fsq, timbre, cns). Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (~30–90 s) → takes[{url}] (pre-signed: curl -OJ, no auth header, 24 h). Cancel: a render that has not reached the GPU yet is stopped and its credits refunded; one already rendering finishes on the GPU (its credits are spent), the job ends as canceled and the output is discarded.

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/"). Provide this, audio_url, or latent_key.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio, as an alternative to audio_key: a doseedo result URL exactly as a job returned it (a stem, a take, a bounce), or any public URL. The gateway fetches it (≤256 MB) into your account's ingest storage before the job starts. Pass audio_key OR audio_url.

duration_seconds.description: REQUIRED. The recording's length in seconds (0.5–600): the take is this long.

fidelity.description: How much of the recording's own latents the take keeps, 0–0.6 (cover noise strength over the source). Default 0: structure from its FSQ codes only, the sound all the instrument's.

fsq.description: false = leave the recording's FSQ codes out: the take follows the server's note roll (needs midi: true) on the instrument's sound, with none of the source's phrasing or articulation carried over — for a line whose phrasing doesn't suit the new instrument (a sung vocal on a sax). Default true. recipe.fsq says which ran.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

instrument.description: REQUIRED. The instrument that plays it — call.instrument from doseedo_instruments (with its call.timbre_preset where it has one).

latent_key.description: Instead of the audio: the recording already VAE-encoded (ACE-Step 1.5 VAE, 48 kHz stereo → [T, 64] at 25 Hz, the latent mean) as a 64-channel 25 Hz float WAV `*.latent.wav`, uploaded like audio (POST /api/jobs/uploads). The server skips its encode. Dø Desktop sends this when encoding on the Mac lands sooner than uploading the audio.

midi.description: true = the server also transcribes the recording's notes into a roll that drives the MIDI hooks beside the FSQ codes — closer notes, a little slower (LatentPitch on audio; vaescriptor on a latent_key; a drum part — either route — gets its hits from vaescriptor_drums). recipe.midi_source names it. Default false: the codes alone.

takes.description: How many takes, 1–4 (default: the server's best-of-N).

timbre_preset.description: A named timbre preset (the catalog's preset ids, e.g. "cello:preset1"). Omit for the instrument default.

name: doseedo_cover_stem
title: Cover a stem on another instrument
